fact: The August 2025 ESMP states the National Data Centre in Lilongwe is designed for two grid feeds from separate ESCOM substations, with one source built under DigMap and the second, a service power line from the Kamuzu Central Hospital substation, still to be built under DMAP; it has two 500kVA diesel generators giving 72 hours of backup and two UPS systems.
title: Environmental and Social Management Plan (ESMP) for the National Data Centre, Digital Malawi Acceleration Project (DMAP P505095)
publisher: Public Private Partnership Commission (PPPC), Government of Malawi
